title: Create carts in v1
body: Use CartClient.create_cart(items) to start a cart in cart-sdk version 1.0. The method returns a cart identifier.

title: Remove an old cart
body: Use CartClient.delete_cart(cart_id) to remove a version 1.0 cart. Deletion is permanent.

title: Total price for version 1
body: Use cart.total_cents to read the final amount. Always format cents on the client.

title: Start a cart session
body: In cart-sdk version 2.0, call CartSession.start(items) to create a cart session. CartClient.create_cart from version 1.0 is no longer available.

title: Cancel cart sessions
body: To remove a cart session, call CartSession.cancel(session_id). The method is valid for version 2.0 and is idempotent.

title: Read checkout totals
body: In cart-sdk version 2.0, use CartSession.total_amount() to retrieve currency and amount. The response includes a currency code.

title: Write inventory levels
body: Set the absolute inventory count using InventoryClient.set_stock(sku, count). The operation overwrites the previous value.

title: Read stock counts
body: Use InventoryClient.get_stock(sku) to read an integer stock quantity from inventory-sdk 1.0.

title: Adjust stock atomically
body: In inventory-sdk version 2.0, InventoryClient.adjust_stock(sku, delta) makes an atomic adjustment. Use a negative delta to decrement stock.

title: Read current inventory
body: In inventory-sdk 2.0, call InventoryClient.snapshot(sku) to read current available and reserved inventory counts.

title: Charge a customer
body: Use BillingClient.charge(customer_id, amount_cents) for version 1.0 billing. This legacy call is not part of version 2.0.

title: Create payment intents
body: Billing version 2.0 uses BillingClient.create_payment_intent(customer_id, amount_cents) instead of direct charges. Confirm the intent before settlement.

title: Check payment state
body: Use BillingClient.intent_status(intent_id) to read pending, confirmed or failed payment status.

title: Return canceled session receipts
body: CartSession.cancel now returns a cancellation receipt from June 2025. Earlier version 2.0 builds did not return receipts.
